summary: No Kocaeli-specific statute, court decision, enforcement incident or institutional practice appears in the source inventory, so no provincial assessment can be made and the national assessment for Turkey applies to a visitor to Kocaeli.
tangentialFactors:
Country-wide monitoring by Kaos GL for 2025, which applies to Kocaeli as elsewhere, records hostility toward LGBTI+ people becoming explicit state policy: "Year of the Family" instructions issued to public institutions, the closure of an LGBTI+ association with criminal cases opened against 11 of its members, and artistic events cancelled or banned.

The same national monitoring counts 6 right-to-life violations including 3 hate-motivated killings, with transgender people the most affected; 89 torture or ill-treatment violations, up from 51 the previous year; roughly 313 violations overall, about 2.5 times the prior year's total; 299 detention decisions; and freedom-of-expression violations rising from 216 to 540. These are national totals with no provincial breakdown, so they cannot be attributed to Kocaeli specifically.
localsOnly: No resident-facing facts specific to Kocaeli were identified in the source inventory; the national framework recorded for Turkey governs LGBTI+ residents of the province.
outOfScopeNotes: The inventory contains no Kocaeli-level data on policing, detention, hate incidents, facilities or local administrative practice. Whether Kocaeli's own authorities have issued family-policy directives, cancelled events, or handled detentions differently from the national pattern is unresolved and not sourced here.
